acts.label: Hard training
acts.gloss: Mars work — give the force a worthy target.
acts.mvp: move for ten minutes at any intensity — the streak matters more than the session

acts.label: Long run / endurance
acts.gloss: Mars pointed down a long road, Saturn keeping the pace.
acts.mvp: go half the distance, slowly

acts.label: Yoga / stretch / walk
acts.gloss: Venus in the body — ease as a practice, not a reward.
acts.mvp: stretch once, standing where you are

acts.label: Deep rest / nap
acts.gloss: Slack water is real rest — the void is for this.
acts.mvp: lie down for ten minutes without your phone

acts.label: Haircut / grooming
acts.gloss: Classical: cut waxing for growth and body; a Venus hour flatters.

acts.label: Start a diet / regimen
acts.gloss: Begin removals on the waning moon — subtraction runs with the tide.

acts.label: Intimacy & sex
acts.gloss: Venus and Mars in the same room — evening tides suit them.

acts.label: Deep study
acts.gloss: Mercury's matter at Saturn's pace, for learning that has to stick.
acts.mvp: read one page properly rather than five badly

acts.label: Write a first draft
acts.gloss: Drafting classically SUITS the retrograde — only the release doesn't.
acts.mvp: write three sentences and stop

acts.label: Edit & revise
acts.gloss: The waning moon cuts; Virgo's water shows every pebble.
acts.mvp: fix one paragraph

acts.label: Learn a new skill
acts.gloss: Mercury gathers, Jupiter gives it somewhere to go.
acts.mvp: do the smallest drill once

acts.label: Plan & strategize
acts.gloss: Saturn frames, Jupiter aims — a New-Moon matter by nature.
acts.mvp: write down the question you are actually trying to answer

acts.label: Research & investigate
acts.gloss: What's hidden yields to Scorpio water and a patient Mercury.
acts.mvp: note what you already know and what is missing

acts.label: Teach / present
acts.gloss: Sun for presence, Mercury for the words, Jupiter for the room.

acts.label: Deep work sprint
acts.gloss: Close the door; Saturn holds it shut.
acts.mvp: twenty minutes on the hardest part, then stop

acts.label: Make art / creative practice
acts.gloss: Venus gives the form, the Moon the image, and Mercury the hand that carries it through.

acts.label: Finish & ship the last 10%
acts.gloss: Endings belong to the waning half — completion runs with the tide.
acts.mvp: close one loose end

acts.label: Organize / declutter
acts.gloss: Clearing suits the void and the waning moon — removal, not launch.
acts.mvp: clear one surface

acts.label: Repair & fix
acts.gloss: Mending what already exists rather than making something new.
acts.mvp: diagnose it, even if you do not fix it today

acts.label: Admin & errands
acts.gloss: Mercury's hour moves the paperwork; the void loses it.
acts.mvp: do the single one that is blocking something else

acts.label: Negotiate / ask for more
acts.gloss: Moon applying to Jupiter is the classic signature for asking big.

acts.label: The hard conversation
acts.gloss: Suits clearing old air; avoid the hours when the Moon and Mars clash.

acts.label: Apply / submit
acts.gloss: The document is Mercury's; your visibility is the Sun's.

acts.label: A date
acts.gloss: Moon applying to Venus, evening tide — the oldest election there is.

acts.label: Time with your partner
acts.gloss: Venus and the Moon describe time together in an existing relationship.

acts.label: Deepen a bond
acts.gloss: The Moon carries the relationship's own weather.
acts.mvp: ask one real question

acts.label: Repair / reconcile
acts.gloss: A waning moon favors going back over old ground gently.

acts.label: Start a dating profile
acts.gloss: A profile is published, not spoken — Venus for the appeal, Mercury for the words, and not while Mercury is retrograde.

acts.label: Ask someone out
acts.gloss: Venus carries the asking; Mars supplies the nerve to send it.

acts.label: Meet someone new
acts.gloss: Jupiter widens the field Venus works in — fifth-house weather with company.

acts.label: Have the where-is-this-going talk
acts.gloss: Saturn is welcome here — it is the conversation that asks a thing to hold shape.

acts.label: Host a gathering
acts.gloss: Jupiter hosts; Venus arranges the room; the Sun warms it.

acts.label: Meet new people / network
acts.gloss: Eleventh-house weather: friends you haven't met.
acts.mvp: reply to the message you have been leaving

acts.label: Family time / call home
acts.gloss: The Moon's own matter — home is wherever it's tended.
acts.mvp: send a message saying you will call

acts.label: Cook & provision
acts.gloss: Nourishment is lunar work — a void afternoon cooks beautifully.
acts.mvp: make one component you can build on tomorrow

acts.label: Beautify the space
acts.gloss: Venus's hour makes the same room land differently.
acts.mvp: put one thing back where it belongs

acts.label: Garden / plant
acts.gloss: Oldest election of all: sow waxing, weed and prune waning.
acts.mvp: water what is already planted

acts.label: Deep clean
acts.gloss: Removal work — the waning moon and even the void carry it.
acts.mvp: one room, or one drawer

acts.label: Budget & ledger
acts.gloss: Going over the numbers rather than committing new money.
acts.mvp: record what you spent, without deciding anything

acts.label: A considered purchase
acts.gloss: Venus governs worth; the void famously mis-buys.

acts.label: Settle / restructure debts
acts.gloss: Eighth-house work: what's entangled gets patiently unwound.

acts.label: Meditate / pray
acts.gloss: The void's slack water is the tradition's gift to this.
acts.mvp: three breaths, counted

acts.label: Journal from feeling
acts.gloss: Moon writes, Mercury holds the pen.
acts.mvp: one line about today

acts.label: Reflection / divination
acts.gloss: Dark-moon days read deepest; the balsamic hush is the classic window.

acts.label: Set an intention / begin a cycle
acts.gloss: Seed at the New Moon; the whole app's cycle rhythm begins here.

acts.label: Grieve & release
acts.gloss: Waning to balsamic — release work rides the emptying tide.

acts.label: Solitude / retreat
acts.gloss: Saturn's monastic gift — containment as kindness.
acts.mvp: take one hour off the grid instead of the day

acts.label: Publish / release
acts.gloss: Timing matters most for the moment the work goes public.

acts.label: Launch a venture / product
acts.gloss: Wants the part of the chart that governs public standing to be strong and unafflicted.

acts.label: Sign a contract
acts.gloss: Two firm rules here: not while Mercury is retrograde, and never while the Moon is void.

acts.label: Move / sign for a home
acts.gloss: Fourth-house election — the Moon strong and building.

acts.label: Begin a partnership
acts.gloss: The tradition's most scrutinized election — Venus clean, Moon applying soft.

Aries.does: starts at full brightness — first, early, loud
Aries.misses: wants the beginning more than the finish

Taurus.does: steady output; the work shows up the same way daily
Taurus.misses: digs in long after the plan changed

Gemini.does: shines by explaining — connects things, gets quoted
Gemini.misses: visible in six places, finished in none

Cancer.does: warmth turned inward — home, and the few who count

Leo.does: whatever you make, you can stand behind in public
Leo.misses: the audience quietly becomes the point

Virgo.does: pride in the craft itself, seen or not
Virgo.misses: nothing ships, because nothing is finished

Libra.does: shines through others — the partner, the collaboration
Libra.misses: your own aim goes missing while you weigh theirs

Scorpio.does: burns narrow and deep; one thing, all the way down
Scorpio.misses: kept so private that nobody can help

Sagittarius.does: purpose looks like distance — the further reach
Sagittarius.misses: the pitch outruns what is actually built

Capricorn.does: recognition earned in public and on the record
Capricorn.misses: waits for permission nobody formally gives

Aquarius.misses: contrary on reflex, even when the room is right

Pisces.does: purpose felt before it can be argued
Pisces.misses: dissolves into whoever else is present

Aries.does: needs met fast — act on the feeling, examine it after
Aries.misses: the mood arrives already dressed as a decision

Taurus.does: settled by food, warmth, and the same chair
Taurus.misses: comfort hardens into refusal to move

Gemini.does: feelings get processed by saying them out loud
Gemini.misses: talked about so thoroughly they never land

Cancer.does: you know what you need without having to ask
Cancer.misses: the past gets re-felt as though it were now

Leo.does: needs to be delighted in, not merely tolerated
Leo.misses: sulks when the room fails to notice

Virgo.does: care shows up as usefulness — you fix what is wrong
Virgo.misses: worry doing an impression of planning

Libra.does: steadied by good company and a pleasant room
Libra.misses: own needs postponed until they surface as grievance

Scorpio.does: feels it at full volume and shows none of it
Scorpio.misses: holds the grudge long past its cause

Sagittarius.does: cheered by motion — a trip, a plan, any horizon
Sagittarius.misses: restless the moment things turn ordinary

Capricorn.does: comfort comes from being on top of it
Capricorn.misses: feelings deferred until there is time, and there never is

Aquarius.does: needs room — company you choose, at a distance you set
Aquarius.misses: detached from your own state until it gets loud

Pisces.does: reads the room before anyone has spoken
Pisces.misses: someone else's mood, wearing your name

Aries.misses: says it before it is true

Taurus.does: slow, thorough, and it stays learned
Taurus.misses: will not reopen a settled opinion

Gemini.does: quick, curious, good in any conversation
Gemini.misses: interested in everything, committed to nothing

Cancer.does: thinks in images and memory; explains by story
Cancer.misses: the mood decides what counts as true

Leo.does: speaks with conviction — people remember the line

Virgo.does: precise; sorts the real from the noise
Virgo.misses: corrects what did not need correcting

Libra.does: states both sides fairly and means it

Scorpio.does: research mind — finds what was meant to stay buried

Sagittarius.does: the shape first, before the parts
Sagittarius.misses: confident about details it never checked

Capricorn.does: plans that survive contact with the week
Capricorn.misses: dismisses what cannot be proven yet

Aquarius.does: sees the pattern above the individual case
Aquarius.misses: loyal to the theory over the evidence

Pisces.does: the answer arrives sideways, and it is often right
Pisces.misses: cannot reconstruct how it got there

Aries.does: direct about wanting; makes the first move
Aries.misses: wants it most in the moment before having it

Taurus.does: real pleasure, real comfort, no apology for either
Taurus.misses: spends on comfort past what it is worth

Gemini.does: charmed by wit; likes people who are interesting
Gemini.misses: interest wanders as soon as someone is known

Cancer.does: loves by feeding people and remembering things
Cancer.misses: care with a small hook in it

Leo.does: generous and warm; makes people feel chosen
Leo.misses: needs the gesture returned where others can see

Virgo.does: love shown by doing the useful thing
Virgo.misses: affection that arrives shaped like a critique

Libra.does: fairness, grace, and the room made pleasant
Libra.misses: peace kept at the cost of the true thing

Scorpio.does: all or nothing — intensity is the point

Sagittarius.does: warm and easy; likes the adventure of a person
Sagittarius.misses: leaves just as it turns ordinary

Capricorn.does: commitment as the proof; shows up for years
Capricorn.misses: warmth withheld until it has been earned

Aquarius.does: loves people as they actually are, oddities included

Pisces.does: forgives more than most people can
Pisces.misses: loves the version of them you imagined

Aries.does: acts first, and the nerve holds
Aries.misses: fights the nearest thing rather than the right one

Taurus.does: slow to start, then impossible to stop
Taurus.misses: digs in at the moment moving would win

Gemini.misses: energy split across too many fronts

Cancer.does: defends people rather than attacking them
Cancer.misses: anger goes sideways instead of straight

Leo.does: bold in the open; performs under pressure
Leo.misses: will not back down while anyone is watching

Virgo.does: effort aimed precisely — the exact fix
Virgo.misses: picks the fight over the small wrong thing

Libra.does: pushes through persuasion instead of force
Libra.misses: conflict avoided until it becomes a rupture

Scorpio.does: sustained, strategic, does not let go
Scorpio.misses: waits to strike rather than saying it now

Sagittarius.does: energy with a direction; goes far and fast

Capricorn.does: disciplined force, applied for as long as it takes
Capricorn.misses: drives the body past what it can pay back

Aquarius.does: fights for the principle rather than the person
Aquarius.misses: cold exactly where heat was needed

Pisces.does: acts on feeling, and best on someone else's behalf
Pisces.misses: effort leaks away with no clear target

Aries.does: grows by going first; luck follows the nerve

Taurus.does: growth you can bank — slow, material, real
Taurus.misses: comfort inflates into too much of it

Gemini.misses: knows a little about far too much

Cancer.does: generous and protective; makes people safe
Cancer.misses: takes on more people than you can hold

Leo.does: big-hearted in the open; brings others up with you
Leo.misses: generosity that needs to be witnessed

Virgo.does: growth through craft, better by increments
Virgo.misses: shrinks the ambition to fit the checklist

Libra.misses: agrees to more than is possible

Scorpio.does: goes where others will not, and grows there

Sagittarius.misses: promises the horizon and skips the ground

Libra.misses: weighed so long that nothing gets decided

Sagittarius.does: beliefs tested before they are kept

Capricorn.misses: the work becomes the whole life
